name: Vinegar (distilled, wine, balsamic, cider, rice)

Pb.basis: food as listed; source unit mg/kg or mg/l

Cd.binding_scope: liquid foods in general except categories with particular limits
Cd.basis: source unit mg/kg or ppm as noted; product/migration basis preserved in notes

tAs.binding_scope: liquid foods in general except categories with particular limits
tAs.basis: source unit mg/kg or ppm as noted; product/migration basis preserved in notes

iAs.label: Inorganic arsenic is a component of total arsenic (iAs <= tAs). No in-force sovereign sets a separate iAs maximum level for this product on its basis, so inorganic arsenic is governed by and bounded by the total arsenic ceiling (100 ug/kg); no separate iAs ceiling is published. The total arsenic is measured on every lot; on ongoing lots iAs is speciated whenever tAs exceeds its reflex trigger.

tHg.basis: food as listed; source unit mg/kg or mg/l

MeHg.label: Methylmercury is a component of total mercury (MeHg <= tHg). No in-force sovereign sets a separate MeHg maximum level for this product on its basis, so methylmercury is governed by and bounded by the total mercury ceiling (50 ug/kg); no separate MeHg ceiling is published. The total mercury is measured on every lot; on ongoing lots MeHg is speciated whenever tHg exceeds its reflex trigger.

Ni.label: Ni 20 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from EU eu20202184_ni_drinking_water_20 (water intended for human consumption). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Cr.label: Cr 50 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from AU nhmrc2025_crvi_drinking_water_50 (drinking water). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis. The source instrument writes the drinking-water chromium ceiling on the hexavalent species; it is adopted here as the total-chromium ceiling and disclosed as such, with the hexavalent fraction bound more tightly in the Cr-VI cell. Disclosed species-as-total ceiling: the anchor is a hexavalent-chromium limit applied as the ceiling for total chromium, which is at least as protective (total Cr ≤ the Cr-VI limit bounds Cr-VI as well); no sovereign sets a total-chromium level for this product on its basis.

Cr-VI.label: Hexavalent chromium is a component of total chromium (Cr-VI <= Cr). No in-force sovereign sets a separate Cr-VI maximum level for this product on its basis, so hexavalent chromium is governed by and bounded by the total chromium ceiling (50 ug/kg); no separate Cr-VI ceiling is published. The total chromium is measured on every lot; on ongoing lots Cr-VI is speciated whenever Cr exceeds its reflex trigger.

Sn.source_scope: canned beverages, including canned fruit and vegetable juices, except canned dried and canned powdered products
Sn.label: Sn 100000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from EU eu2023_sn_canned_beverages_100000 (canned beverages, including canned fruit and veg). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Al.label: Al 200 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from EU eu20202184_al_drinking_water_200 (water intended for human consumption). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Vietnam QCVN 8-2 is the only sovereign that sets vinegar MLs (Pb 500, Cd 1000, tAs 200, tHg 50), so it governs directly. Hidden-hazard flag for the ratchet, NOT a missing limit: the FDA has issued balsamic- and wine-vinegar lead warning letters (grape-derived lead concentrated during must reduction, compounded historically by lead-bearing equipment), and measured balsamic lead can approach or exceed 500 ug/kg — so ALARA and the occurrence ratchet drive tightening after publication even though the sovereign ceiling is the correct initial value. Nickel and total chromium are held under a stainless-steel-migration screen because an acidic food in prolonged stainless contact leaches both.
